author: Unity
description:
Catch the official session recording from Unite Seoul! Dive into the roadmap presentation as we unveil the key enhancements, workflow evolutions, and core foundational updates leading straight into Unity 7.

Whether you’re an indie dev or managing a studio, this roadmap lays out how we are making Unity faster, more efficient, and more deeply integrated with next-gen workflows.

Key highlights in this session: 
✅ .NET Modernization: We’re breaking down the transition to modern C# and .NET capabilities, bringing you significant performance boosts and new language features.
✅ Supercharged URP: Get a first look at the latest enhancements coming to the Universal Render Pipeline—optimized for stunning visuals and rock-solid performance across all platforms.
✅ Next-Gen In-App Purchases (IAP): We are refining monetization tools to help you seamlessly integrate, test, and scale your game economy.
✅ ...and much more! From editor quality-of-life improvements to core engine stability updates.

🔗
title: The Unity Engine Roadmap | Unite Seoul 2026
